items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: If I'm not mistaken, he still had Frank Troll I think, didn't he?

ctx.x: And George Van Epps and the Guitar Tealers was another big thing in that record to me.
If I'm not mistaken, he still had Frank Troll I think, didn't he?
He might have. I know Charlotte was Frank.
